note: Self-test fixture for validate:admission-level-stability. Covers all three failure shapes: answers/phase4/a.html is promoted baseline -> full by the build (what generate_aplayer_phase_expansion.mjs did to all 1,400 of its pages); manual/b.html is demoted full -> baseline, which silently removes a published page from the substantive checks; and dup/d.html leaves the build carrying two different levels at once, so row order would otherwise decide which contract it is judged against.
